reuse.why: Uses the shared fill-rules helpers shouldFillCategory and averageToBudgetAmount plus getSheetValue/setBudget/batchMessages, and registers the handler with the same mutator(undoable(...)) wrapper as its siblings.

duplication.why: The category SELECT and the filter-and-set loop are copied from set3MonthAvg (already repeated in set6/12MonthAvg) rather than factored out, though the decision logic itself stays in the shared helpers.

placement.why: The action sits in budget/actions.ts next to the other month-wide actions and the method is registered in budget/app.ts alongside them.

scope.why: Only the new action, its registration and a test are added; no unrelated edits.

maintainability.why: Short and consistent with existing actions; the only cost is one more copy of the category query/loop boilerplate.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Category selection and sign conversion go through shouldFillCategory and averageToBudgetAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied SQL query and loop are verbatim from set3MonthAvg, not reshaped.
